import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare the data for visualization
breed_counts = data['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10).reset_index()
breed_counts.columns = ['Breed', 'Count']

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.barplot(x='Count', y='Breed', data=breed_counts, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds Registered in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Registrations')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')
plt.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
